direct_target_deltas.delta: Canonical effect authority and lifecycle now separate authorization, atomic reservation, external attempt, uncertain outcome, verification and re-entry. Confirmation validation is pure; optional confirmation consumption is required to be atomic with durable reservation. EffectAttempt now carries authorization and reservation hashes. A discovered request-hash/authorization-hash identity bug was repaired so the attempt binds semantic_hash(auth), not auth.request_hash.

Collapsed a duplicate standalone authority experiment into a thin compatibility facade over canonical frank.effects; no second EffectClass/EffectDecision/request/confirmation type system remains intended.

Self-repo mutation authority is now surface-classified. Operational state/effect queue/telemetry/self-observation proposals may be capability-gated target writes; Harness/cognitive/security/workflow/test/build/documentation-policy/research-or-acceptance-receipt surfaces are hard denied; unknown repo surfaces fail closed.

External-provider retry semantics now distinguish stable idempotency keys from verified provider same-key retry safety; unknown provider outcomes require reconciliation unless the exact provider operation proves same-key retry safety.
Added canonical UnifiedDB V14 tables for effect reservations, one-shot confirmation consumptions and append-only lifecycle events with request/authorization/idempotency/outcome/re-entry identity.
V14 is appended to the explicit Research-Entity-only migration chain. Normal runtime opens existing state only and never implicitly migrates/creates schema.

Implemented atomic BEGIN IMMEDIATE confirmation-consumption + reservation in the existing canonical UnifiedDB; begin-attempt/outcome/re-entry/trace verification/recovery; added executable retry_uncertain_attempt only for verified same-key-safe effects and reconcile_uncertain_outcome for independently observed provider outcomes.

Test-mode canonical UnifiedDB gate covers migration idempotence, atomic reservation, fault rollback, restart replay, real child-process death, same-confirmation concurrency, non-idempotent retry denial + reconciliation, idempotent retry + verification, re-entry, semantic tamper and no implicit schema creation.

Loopback provider experiment commits an effect then intentionally loses the HTTP response. Same-key-safe retry produces one provider resource; non-idempotent effect is reconciled without blind retry; negative control blind non-idempotent retry produces two resources.
Actual tracked target repository is classified into operational, protected and unknown mutation surfaces with fail-closed unknown semantics and adversarial path tests.

architecture_conclusion: Effect authority must be represented as a five-boundary causal chain rather than one ALLOW boolean: policy authorization -> atomic local reservation/one-shot confirmation consumption -> external attempt -> outcome certainty/reconciliation -> provenance-bound re-entry. Each boundary has a distinct receipt/hash/recovery rule and none may be inferred from model text, GWT ignition, ClayGraph salience or prior local success.
